summary: Describes using entropy labels to improve load balancing across MPLS networks. It defines the concept, explains why such labels are useful, and lists properties that allow maximal benefit. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: If trucks all look alike, a road cannot split them evenly. An entropy label is like a random sticker so routers can spread the trucks across many roads.
